body_md:
Five Fort Myers pool and spa contractors are listed here as independently owned, with a license check already done. Each has a Current, Active Certified Pool/Spa Contractor license in the Florida DBPR licensee lookup, and each ownership check names an individual owner or officer with no parent company shown. License records and contacts were checked on 2026-10-29.

## How we picked

Entries are Fort Myers pool and spa contractors. License type, number, status, expiration, and scope come from the Florida DBPR licensee lookup and link to that DBPR source. Ownership was checked on the company site when available and on the Florida filing; each filing named an individual manager or officer and showed no parent company. Years, service area, phone, and website are included only when a source states them. Contacts were checked on 2026-10-29.

## At a glance

- All five licenses are Current, Active and expire on 08/31/2028: Spiro Custom Pools (CPC1458672), Bahama Pools of Florida Inc (CPC1459411), Jackson Pools, Inc. (CPC022504), Certified Pool Solutions Inc (CPC1456919), and Artesian Pool Construction, Inc. (CPC1456505).
- Stated service areas differ. Spiro Custom Pools lists Lee, Collier, and Charlotte counties, including Fort Myers, Cape Coral, Naples, Bonita Springs, Estero, Ave Maria, Babcock Ranch, Marco Island, Sanibel, Captiva, and Pine Island. Bahama Pools of Florida Inc lists Lee County (including Fort Myers, Cape Coral, Lehigh Acres, Bonita Springs, and Estero), Hendry County, Collier County, and Charlotte County. Jackson Pools, Inc. lists Southwest Florida, with offices stated in Fort Myers, Naples, Sarasota, and St. Petersburg. Service area was not stated for Certified Pool Solutions Inc or Artesian Pool Construction, Inc.
- Years stated in the sources: Bahama Pools of Florida Inc, family-owned and operated since 1962; Jackson Pools, Inc., 42 years on the company site; Artesian Pool Construction, Inc., started in 1995, with the company site stating more than 30 years; Spiro Custom Pools, founded in 2012. Years in business were not stated for Certified Pool Solutions Inc.
- DBPR scope is not the same on every record. Bahama Pools of Florida Inc, Jackson Pools, Inc., and Artesian Pool Construction, Inc. can build or repair any swimming pool or spa, public or private. Spiro Custom Pools can build residential swimming pools and repair residential and public swimming pools or spas; that record states the license cannot build public pools. Certified Pool Solutions Inc can repair or service any swimming pool or spa, public or private, including equipment, interior finishes, heaters, and perimeter and filter piping. Each record states the license cannot make direct connections to water or sewer lines.

## Things to know before you go

Use the DBPR scope above to match a new public pool, a new residential pool, or a repair. Each DBPR record states the license cannot make direct connections to water or sewer lines. All five addresses are in Fort Myers.

Listed phones are Spiro Custom Pools, (239) 703-7294; Bahama Pools of Florida Inc, (239) 445-5530; and Jackson Pools, Inc., (239) 495-6700. Artesian Pool Construction, Inc. has a website listed and no phone listed. No phone or website was listed for Certified Pool Solutions Inc.

## FAQ

### Are these companies independently owned?

On these checks, yes. No parent company was shown. Jeffrey Spiro, Jr. (Spiro Custom Pools; site states locally owned; SPIRO, JEFFREY is manager of Spiro Services, LLC). W. Dennis Gray and Danny Gray (Bahama Pools of Florida Inc; site states family-owned and operated since 1962; Danny L. Gray is president; DBPR licensee GRAY, DANNY L). Chad Jackson (Jackson Pools, Inc.; started the company on his own; filing lists JACKSON, CHAD as PDST). Aaron Oldham Reed (Certified Pool Solutions Inc; filing lists Aaron O. Reed as sole officer and registered agent; DBPR primary name REED, AARON OLDHAM). Joseph A. Polotto, president, and Florence B. Polotto, CFO (Artesian Pool Construction, Inc.; site states locally owned and operated).

### Do these licenses expire on the same date?

Yes. All five are Current, Active in the Florida DBPR licensee lookup and expire on 08/31/2028. Contacts were checked on 2026-10-29.

### What is outside every license here?

Each DBPR record states the license cannot make direct connections to water or sewer lines.
